title: Möbius Transformations in the Second Symmetric Product of ℂ
content: In this paper, we defined as an extension, the Möbius transformations in the space F2(ℂ), the second symmetric product of the complex plane ℂ with its natural topology induced by the Hausdorff metric. That is, consider T a Möbius transformation of ℂ and define the map T({z, w}) = {T(z), T(w)} in F2(ℂ). We prove general properties for these maps in F2(ℂ), with focus in the structure of the generators, the properties of transitivity, and the geometry of the conjugacy classes.
